notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana that has flash and/or flying.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with flash and/or flying, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
